svg.title: Shared trip information, personal screens
svg.desc: Cocoon Cabin English portfolio. 2560 x 1440 SVG with an embedded 3840 x 2160 background and editable Inter text.

text.tspan: The shared display explains the journey. The armrest display brings a personal interface within reach.
Shared display / visible across the cabin
Interface concept: destination, music and temperature.
Quest prototype: screen images change with boarding
and seating stages, and move together with the seat.
Once stopped at the destination, the shared display confirms arrival.
Report pp. 12-14, team UI and project textures. Environment controls are conceptual; the prototype shows screen content through stage-based image changes.
